svg.aria-label: Advanced Elastic Alignment: Special Geometries and Tools
svg.title: Advanced Elastic Alignment: Special Geometries and Tools
svg.desc: Seven tools beyond the basic Karcher mean, each with a small computed sketch: coarse-to-fine multiresolution alignment, closed-curve alignment with a start-point search, partial matching of a short template inside a longer curve, transfer alignment between populations, the elastic geodesic between two curves, the Gaussian generative model of amplitude and phase, and peak-persistence selection of lambda.
svg.text: Advanced Elastic Alignment: Special Geometries and Tools
Variants of the elastic aligner for special data, plus tools for paths, sampling and λ
